t: What Medical Device Performance Database Is All About
title: What Medical Device Performance Database Is All About
description: Medical devices range from tongue depressors (Class I) to pacemakers and AI diagnostics (Class III, strictest review). Performance is tracked through MAUDE (FDA's adverse event database) and recalls: metal-on-metal hip implants shed debris (recalled), while modern drug-eluting stents cut restenosis dramatically. The 510(k) pathway clears devices 'substantially equivalent' to existing ones — faster, but debated. Reference information, not medical advice. This database is the complete medical device: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
